10012181.name: Snowboard Legends
10012181.publisher: YASH FUTURE TECH SOLUTIONS PVT LTD
10012181.description:
Get ready for a thrilling snowboarding adventure! This game lets you ride through 12 exciting tracks filled with jumps, sharp turns, and breathtaking snowy landscapes. Race down steep slopes, carve through icy forests, and discover hidden shortcuts. Perfect for beginners and pros alike, this game brings the fun and challenge of real snowboarding to your screen!
Features:
-12 Unique Tracks: Each track offers a different environment and set of challenges, from rugged mountains to smooth forest trails.
-Easy Controls: Simple, intuitive controls make it easy to learn but challenging to master.
-Beautiful Winter Environments: Stunning, detailed graphics immerse you in a realistic snowy world.
Experience the rush of snowboarding

10005735.name: The Golden Age
10005735.description:
This year you have been assigned to be the CEO of the Gold mine.
To start mining the gold and become the biggest gold mine in the world.
Good Luck and Have Fun.

10011944.name: The Jumping Burger Rush - PS4 & PS5
10011944.description:
Cross-buy:
With the purchase of this bundle you will receive the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 version of the game.
Cross-Save:
Pick up playing on the PlayStation®5 exactly where you left off on the PlayStation®4 at any time by simply importing the save game from the PlayStation®4 version!
From the creative minds at The Jumping Food Games comes a fast-paced endless game that will put your reflexes to the test: "The Jumping Burger Rush". In this neon-colored adventure, you control a jumping burger through the vastness of the galaxy and try to push your high score higher and higher.
Adrenaline-pumping gameplay: Test your reflexes in a fast and challenging endless game in which you have to maneuver your burger through a dangerous, neon-lit galaxy.
Endless challenges: Dodge obstacles, overcome tricky passages and collect points to beat your own high score - over and over again!
Highscore hunt: Can you manage to break your personal record time and time again and dominate the leaderboard? Prove your skill and outdo yourself!
Jump, dodge and maneuver your burger through the infinite galaxy. Can you master the unstoppable pace and beat your high score?

10005407.name: The Jumping Fries
10005407.description:
Join BIG F on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump!
Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

10016712.name: Tube Repairs
10016712.description:
Step into a retro-inspired maze as a quick-footed plumber on a mission to repair leaking pipes. Earn points, climb levels, and survive the rising steam in this throwback arcade challenge!

10016257.publisher: Fabrizio Ballante trading as Colosseum Studio
10016257.description: Test your skills and guide the ball into the hole across 15 levels of increasing difficulty!

10012086.name: Daylight Dread
10012086.description: We all know you love shooting zombies, so what are you waiting for? Come, explore around and increase your body count...

10013819.name: Duck Duck Shoot
10013819.description:
Step right up to the most charming shooting gallery this side of the midway! This delightful arcade shooter brings the nostalgic magic of classic carnival games right to your fingertips, combining retro fairground charm with modern gaming excitement.
Step into a beautifully crafted world where colorful rubber ducks bob and weave across a shimmering water track, each one waiting to test your sharpshooting skills. From classic yellow ducks to rare golden specimens and tricky color-changing variants, every target brings its own challenge and rewards. The game captures the authentic feel of vintage carnival attractions with its warm, glowing lights, hand-painted wooden booth designs, and cheerful carnival music that'll transport you straight back to those summer fairground memories.

10015650.name: The Jumping Food Racing - PS4 & PS5
10015650.description:
Cross-buy:
With the purchase of this bundle you will receive the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 version of the game.
Cross-Save:
Pick up playing on the PlayStation®5 exactly where you left off on the PlayStation®4 at any time by simply importing the save game from the PlayStation®4 version!
Now it's getting fast - and tasty! In The Jumping Food Racing, you compete with your favorite foods on a variety of race tracks. Speed and responsiveness are what counts here.
Different tracks, increasing challenges:
Master tight bends, dangerous obstacles and increasing levels of difficulty on ever new tracks in the typical food design.
Comic graphics meet racing fun:
With the familiar style of the Jumping Food Games, this racing game offers action, humor and challenges for all ages.
Choose your favorite dish and go full throttle.
The Jumping Food Racing - ready for the craziest race of your life?

10012039.name: 2048 Snake
10012039.description:
Imagine a mix of classic snake and puzzle game 2048 and there you have a unique gameplay in front of you that you can try right now.  Run and grow your snake on different challenging levels and discover new big numbers on the cubes.
Use the power-ups for help and reorganize the snake to get the bigger numbers. Move faster, use the magnet or any other boost - try it all!
Cross-Save:
Pick up where you left off on PlayStation®4 at any time on PlayStation®5 by simply importing your save game from the PlayStation®4 version!
Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team.
Create the biggest snake in the game with the highest score possible.

10016616.name: Beauty Clicker
10016616.description:
Beauty Clicker combines the thrill of a fast-paced timing challenge with the charm of anime artistry.
Watch as PlayStation’s iconic button symbols fall rhythmically onto the screen. Hit the right button at the perfect moment to reveal pieces of high-resolution anime girl illustrations hidden behind a dark background. With every completed puzzle, a new and captivating illustration awaits.
Featuring eye-catching artwork, simple yet addictive gameplay, and the familiar PlayStation controls, this experience will appeal to both anime fans and players who enjoy short but satisfying gaming sessions.
Beauty Clicker — With every perfect hit, uncover the most beautiful side of art.

10011425.name: Color Snake
10011425.description: New gameplay of the classic snake game. Collect the color you need to complete the levels. Pick up boosts to make things easier. Change skins to make your snake look stylish and unique!

10015266.name: Daemonfall
10015266.description:
When hell touches the sky, your final battle begins.
Face endless hordes, secure the zone, build your defenses – and survive the night.
Retro vibes meet modern action. No refuge. No retreat. Just you – and the fall of the daemons.

10006546.name: Find the Bug
10006546.description: Find the different bug and tag him. Perfect game to learn the differences.

216298.name: Joe Dever's Lone Wolf Console Edition
216298.description:
Lone Wolf is back in video game form with a brand-new story, a deep combat system, stunning graphics and much more!
Acclaimed author Joe Dever played an active role in the development of the game and his new narrative follows on from his classic 1980's gamebook, shedding a new light on Lone Wolf’s world, Magnamund!
The Console Edition includes all 4 acts of the story. Are you ready to write your own destiny?
▪ A brand-new adventure written by Joe Dever, with a deep and dark redesign of Lone Wolf, his world and his enemies.
▪ A real medieval tome with hand-drawn illustrations.
▪ Create your character and try out different combinations of Kai Disciplines, traits and gear.
▪ Write your own story through multiple choices.
▪ A real combat system, where your prowess really counts –no random number table or dice to throw!
▪ Wield Lone Wolf’s signature weapon, the Sommerswerd!
▪ Play again, make different choices and explore new paths and fighting styles!
For Sommerlund and the Kai!
1 player
1080p HD Video Output

10006556.description: Learn the difference between big and small letters. Best Game for your pre school kid to learn which letter is which.

10010380.name: Marble Maze
10010380.description:
Cross-save:
Continue playing on the PlayStation®5 exactly where you left off on the PlayStation®4 at any time by simply importing the savegame from the PlayStation®4 version!
Embark on an exciting journey through an addictive puzzle game that will put your gray matter to the test!
Discover 50 exciting levels full of puzzles and fun!
No less than 50 unique levels await you in Marble Maze, each with its own puzzles, challenges and secrets. From easy entry levels to challenging masterpieces, there's something here for every puzzle enthusiast. Each level offers a new opportunity to improve your thinking skills and refine your solving strategies.
Challenge yourself and improve your best time!
Do you think you have what it takes to break the best times? Test your skills and speed by trying to complete each level as quickly as possible. Every second counts and only the best players will make it to the top of the leaderboard. Are you ready to push your limits and improve your personal best time?
In memory of a very special person.

10006550.name: Match Master
10006550.description: Learn how to make pairs with us. Game for your child in any age.

10011679.name: Orbital Dance
10011679.description:
Step into the boundless expanse of the cosmos in Orbital Dance, a vibrant and mesmerizing adventure where you take on the role of a daring pilot navigating through a kaleidoscopic universe filled with wonders and dangers alike. In this fast-paced, action-packed experience, you’ll soar through an array of dazzling levels, mastering the delicate art of orbital flight as you collect elusive orbits and avoid the perilous obstacles that stand in your way.
In Orbital Dance, you are tasked with controlling a sleek spacecraft equipped for high-speed, precision flying. Your mission is deceptively simple: collect as many orbits as you can. However, the challenge intensifies as you traverse an ever-changing series of beautifully crafted levels, each brimming with vibrant colors, dynamic environments, and increasing hazards. Asteroids of all shapes and sizes hurtle through space, threatening to destroy your ship if you don’t stay on your toes—or, rather, thrusters.
One of the unique features of Orbital Dance is the intricate flight mechanic. As a pilot, you must not only fly through space but also master the gravitational forces of various celestial bodies. By getting close to planets, moons, and stars, you can use their orbits to slingshot your way across the level, gaining speed and reaching otherwise inaccessible areas. Precision and timing are everything as you maneuver through these orbits while dodging deadly asteroids.
Each orbit you collect increases your score and can unlock special bonuses and power-ups. But there’s a catch—missing an orbit or staying too long in one can slow you down, and time is of the essence. The levels are filled with a variety of obstacles that will test your reflexes and decision-making skills, from asteroid fields to space debris, black holes, and more. Only the most skilled pilots will be able to collect all orbits while surviving the hazards of deep space.

233994.name: Ys IX: Monstrum Nox
233994.description:
Experience the thrilling adventure of Ys IX: Monstrum Nox as it pierces through the shadows onto PS5™! After being cursed by a mysterious woman, Adol Christin becomes a Monstrum—a powerful being who can exorcize monsters. To escape from the prison city of Balduq, Adol must ally with five other Monstrums, each with their own unique Gifts, and stop the Grimwald Nox, a shadowy dimension on the brink of overflowing into the real world!

10006498.description: The deluxe adventure you and your friends need. Collect coins with the main here of the game The Pig D. Help him!

10017308.name: Fire jump
10017308.publisher: Fabrizio Ballante trading as Colosseum Studio
10017308.description: In Fire Jump, you will guide a brave girl across a series of platforms suspended above a sea of burning lava. Every jump is a challenge: some platforms are stable, while others sway or move. A moment of distraction could mean the end! Carefully calculate timing and distance, stay focused, and find the best path to reach the finish line.

10005845.name: Geometric Sniper - Blood in Paris
10005845.description:
As a sniper, you'll have to pay attention to the details and find the perfect moment to shoot. Your targets know they are wanted and will try to hide in a variety of ways. Have the patience to establish a clear shot, memorizing the information for each mission.
Game Modes:
Adventure:
Across 10 missions, every detail counts, from carefully observing mission information to finding the perfect opportunity to shoot.
Elite:
Complete the 10 adventure missions without the help of zoom and precision.
Mercenary:
Have fun with new challenges and earn money to pay damages to the family of the civilian that you mistakenly killed during the missions.
Survival:
Find randomly generated targets on the map while snipers look for you.
Find:
Search for various objects scattered throughout these 10 missions and hit them before time runs out.

10016352.name: Memory Holder: The Numbers
10016352.description:
They lead to infinite possibilities, yet they have a modest beginning.
As with many things in life, the numbers are here to stay.
They might be more prevalent in some lives compared to others, but each of us will regularly encounter them on our journey.
As such, it is probably best to get used to them from a young age.
• Memorize the numbers across fifteen stages
• Concentrate and try to achieve a maximum rank on every stage
• Earn enough stars to unlock all collection rewards

momentum based platforming with wall running

levels have different side challenges to complete

10006162.description: Do you want to learn some amazing facts about basketball? We have the right game for you The Basketball Quiz.

210935.name: Toki Tori 2+
210935.description:
Five Ancient Frogs, scattered across the countryside, send a telepathic message to Toki Tori. It’s hard to see how this young chicken could help them destroy the floating crystal endangering everything… but he’s their only hope.
Toki Tori 2+ may look cute, but it’s a challenging puzzle adventure game. Whistle and stomp are the only moves you need to solve increasingly complex puzzles, as you manipulate strange critters’ behaviour and go anywhere, anytime on a lush forest island.
• A unique take on the Metroidvania formula: progress by exploring, observing and experimenting
• Find the Ancient Frogs and destroy the crystal at the heart of the island
• Whistle songs for special abilities, including rewind and fast travel
• Use the in-game camera and snap creature pictures to complete the Tokidex
• Push the game’s mechanics to their limits to get 15 achievements and 100s of golden wings
1 player

10004810.name: Ape Escape Academy
10004810.description:
Experience Ape Escape™ Academy originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
To become an expert in monkey business, you first have to go to monkey school, so enroll now at the craziest college the world has ever seen. You can work your way up through the school years by winning wacky mini-games but keep an eye on your classmates – students they may be, but when it comes to trouble and tomfoolery, these goofy monkeys are pros!
So, you think you’ve got what it takes to make it to the top of the Academy? Then it’s time to test your skills in 50 mini-games, including all-time ape favorites like Monkey Matador, 1.00 Meter Dash, Chef Chimpy, Monkey Soccer and Banana Guardian!

200102.name: Assassin’s Creed® Chronicles: China
200102.description:
Exact Shao Jun’s vengeance on the Chinese Emperor in stunning 16th century China with fresh 2.5D stealth gameplay:
• Witness an empire crumbles:
Meet iconic historical figures and discover the great Empire of China during the Ming Dynasty
• Immerse yourself in a unique art direction:
Dive into a beautiful Chinese setting  with traditional brush paintings
• Stealth in a new dimension:
Experience the thrill of being a master Assassin in 2.5D. Sneak and hide to avoid detection and fool enemies using whistles and disguises
• Experience a fast & fluid “assault course":
Whether you’re running from danger, negotiating obstacles or stealthily climbing you will truly feel the freedom of moving as an Assassin
• Shao Jun’s arsenal is in your hands:
Use Shao Jun’s stylish and empowering combat arsenal: close-combat martial arts, a powerful Kian Sword and her hidden Shoe Blade
• Navigate multiple planes:
Switch between environmental layers and choose the right path according to your needs

233243.name: Figment
233243.description:
A musical action-adventure set in the recesses of the human mind... Welcome to the world of Figment. A strange and surreal world a place filled with our deepest thoughts, urges and memories, populated by the many voices we hear in our heads.
This mind has been quiet and calm for many years. But something has changed. New thoughts have started to emerge - taking the shape of nightmarish creatures who spread fear wherever they go. The only hope is for the grumpy Dusty, the mind's former voice of courage, to get back to his old self and help the mind to face its fears.
Join Dusty and his ever-optimistic friend, Piper, on an adventure through the different sides of the mind, solving puzzles to set things straight, beating back the nightmares and seeking to restore the courage that's been lost.

10010734.name: ExitSlum11
10010734.description:
Rules are simple:
If you observe an anomaly, something out-of-place or something not-seen-before, run back to where you started.
Otherwise, keep running.
When you reach Exit 11, you’ll manage to escape from this nightmare.

10005195.name: The Dog K
10005195.description: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Eat cookies with the main hero of the game The Dog K. Eat all the cookies in the world!

10012912.name: Blues of War
10012912.description:
"Blues of War" is a thought-provoking combination of quiz and visual novel that explores the complex nature of war. The game first challenges players with a comprehensive war-themed quiz that tests their knowledge, then immerses them in a compelling story set in the depths of Zordak forest.
Enjoy your quiz test first, and then unlock a short, dramatic movie about veterans of war!

10006346.name: Caravan Journey
10006346.description: Join this Caravan Journey thorough the camping in the car. Enjoy the graphics with the best tunes.

10016667.name: Drizzlepath: Picturae
10016667.description:
Have you ever wandered inside images? Images that blow your soul away? In Drizzlepath: Picturae, you embark on a journey of gorgeous landscapes. While some of these landscapes melt your heart, some will give you the chills.
Do not fear though; at the end of the day, you will have a heck of a good time viewing a variety of beauties, listening to haunting music, and a real talent of a voice actor.
In this pure walking simulator, there is an intro and an outro chapter, and between these two, you will have to find hidden black foxes at the end of each scene. All you have to do is to keep your eyes open for every detail.
If you have an hour to take a no-sweat walk from vistas to vistas, wait no more. Just dive into the world of Drizzlepath: Picturae right now!

10006449.name: The Jumping Muffin
10006449.description: Join BIG M on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

10006181.name: Weeping Willow
10006181.description:
Weeping Willow is a kinetic visual novel in the genre of detective story, which takes place in the small medieval town of Weidendorf. This town was quarantined due to an outbreak of plague in poor neighborhoods.
The story begins with the mysterious disappearance of the husband of the main character, Baron Von Wolf. A few days later he was found in the local parish of the Scarlet Rose Order, but the baroness claims that she does not recognize her husband. Other people confirms the identity of the impostor and no one believes her. Because of the plague quarantine, the young Baroness is a captive of her own home and begins to seriously fear for her life. After this, a series of dramatic events unfold that will irrevocably change her life.
This short story will delight its players with a fascinating plot tied to intrigues, betrayals, and conspiracies.
Features:
- An intriguing and unpredictable plot
- Unexpected ending
- Female main character
- Memorable animated characters and detailed backgrounds

10011374.name: Anomaly Pools
10011374.description:
You are afraid of water, don’t even get close to water.
Keep running all the time!
Anomalies will spawn randomly on your path, just in front of…
The moment you see an anomaly, turn back and run away from it, as far as you can.
If you manage to notice and run away from 11 anomalies, you’ll escape this nightmare.
In the meantime, the pool lady “loves” you and chases you! Don’t ever get caught to her.
But she is shy! If you look at her, she’ll stop moving!
Always watch your back, because the pool lady will always be chasing you…

10008452.name: Naive Boy Super Lash
10008452.description:
Do you like whips? Have you ever wanted an accurate, next-generation, stimulating whip simulator? Well, this game is far from it, but at least it tries!
Take control of Jim-Jack Rousseau’s trusty whip and progress through 11 levels in this small adventure. Follow your dreams of becoming the hero you always wanted to be… or not…
And maybe by the end of this, you’ll learn the absolute meaning of the state of nature*
(*note: it says “maybe”)

10009874.name: Arcade Paradise VR
10009874.description:
Enter the virtual realm in Arcade Paradise VR, transporting you back to 1993 for an all-new immersive experience oozing with retro-fuelled gaming nostalgia. Taking you on an empowering journey from rags to riches, Arcade Paradise is an adventure and light-management sim combo game where you transform the decrepit King Wash laundromat into a thriving business.
Set in the rundown town of Grindstone, you play as Ashley, a rebel teenager going against your father’s wishes to continue the family business. Get hands on managing the fully gamified day-to-day tasks, from manually picking up gum, doing the laundry, and scrubbing a toilet perfectly clean - to throwing out the trash in a basketball style mini game. Then, take your hard-earned money from completing these tasks to unlock your real objective… buying more arcade units!
Featuring 12 fully realized VR cabinets alongside 27 traditionally controlled games from the original release, it’s time to play, profit and purchase your way to your very own Arcade Paradise. So, strap on your latest virtual reality tech - because the future is NOW!
Exclusive VR Cabinets
From intense basketball action to games that will test your strength, dexterity and endurance, Arcade Paradise brings 6 exclusive arcade cabinets to VR across a variety of genres. Alongside this, 6 classic cabinets have been enhanced for VR including favorites such as UFO Assault, Smoke ‘Em and more.
From Rags to Arcade Riches
Convert a derelict family-run laundromat in the rundown town of Grindstone into a thriving arcade business. Manually pick up gum, clean the toilet, do the laundry, throw out the trash and manage profits to use your hard-earned coin to flip the family laundromat business into an Arcade Paradise.
Genre-Bending Gameplay
Featuring a wide range of gameplay, from the fully gamified laundry chores to each of the 39 cabinets you can purchase in-game, Arcade Paradise is a fully immersive simulation game. Test out your basketball skills by throwing out the trash, before taking a shot on the ‘Basketball Blast’ cabinet.
Each cabinet features its own gameplay, stories, missions and high scores to set with competition online leaderboards - from full RPG campaigns, beat ‘em ups, and physical sports games, all inspired by 3 decades of gaming.
Coming of Age Storytelling
A love letter to the 1990’s, Arcade Paradise lets you step into the role of Ashley, a rebel teenager going against your berating father’s wishes to continue in his footsteps in running the family-run laundromat business. Whilst your father, Gerald (voiced by Doug Cockle), is away in the Riviera, you take this as an opportunity to prove yourself by transforming his laundromat into the ultimate arcade.
A Boundary Breaking Soundtrack
From the individual games to choosing what song to put on the jukebox inspired by some of the great records of the early 90s, with 11 new tracks exclusive to VR, the soundtrack captures the heart of a bygone era.

10010298.name: ARMORED CORE MASTER OF ARENA
10010298.description:
ARMORED CORE MASTER OF ARENA is the 3rd entry in the mech action and customisation series.
Choose and freely combine from a huge number of parts, including head, core, arms, legs and weapons, to create your own original mech before taking it into combat.
With the help of Operator Lana Neilson, the player becomes a Raven, and carries out a variety of missions as they seek revenge for the loss of their family at the hands of Hustler One - the top-ranked Raven and pilot of the infamous Nine-Ball AC.
Players will also encounter the Arena, where their skills are put to the test against numerous AC pilots.
This software is a conversion of the Playstation® version for use with PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5. Some areas may differ from the PlayStation® version, and some features may not function as originally intended.

10004656.name: echochrome
10004656.description:
Experience echochrome originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
Are you ready for a whole new kind of mental workout?
Feed your brain and exercise your imagination as you tackle mind-bending optical puzzles and topsy-turvy 3D mazes.
Think fast, spinning each level to make new pathways and avoid dead ends.
No game stretches your mind like echochrome.

234806.name: Erica
234806.description:
Immerse yourself in an interactive live-action thriller which puts you at the heart of the mystery.
•	Delve into Erica’s past as you piece together the shocking truth behind her father’s death.
•	Face the consequences of your actions as you influence how the narrative unfolds and arrive at multiple alternative endings.
•	Reach into the world by interacting with clues using your DUALSHOCK®4 wireless controller or the Erica app for iOS and Android*.
*App download, Wi-Fi connection and compatible iOS or Android smartphone required.

10008233.name: Grandia
10008233.description:
Take the role of Justin, a young boy obsessed with becoming a great adventurer, who inherits a magic stone that leads him on an epic journey to uncover the mystery of a long lost civilization in this classic RPG.
Meet an exciting cast of characters who join you along the way and unravel the mysteries of this ancient legend.
Grandia is an unforgettable journey with over 80 hours of gameplay, with a ground-breaking strategic battle system featuring over 200 weapons and items to collect and more than 80 magic spells and techniques to master.
One of the most critically-acclaimed games of its time, Grandia helped shape the RPG genre as we know it today.
Download this RPG and experience the epic adventure today!

10008138.name: MediEvil
10008138.description:
Experience MediEvil™ originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
•	Challenge the powers of darkness and untold magic as Sir Daniel Fortesque returns from the grave to battle an evil sorcerer’s plans of demise. (As if being dead wasn’t bad enough!) Follow the mystical trail of darkness and land in the journey of a lifetime.
•	A mighty arsenal of weapons awaits: swords, daggers, crossbows, hammers, the occasional chicken drumstick and more!
•	Fiendish puzzles and riddles to solve!
•	Ghoulish enemies that will strike fear in the bravest of enemies!
•	A spine-tingling soundtrack.

Experience Star Wars Bounty Hunter™ for PS2™ like never before! Featuring full 1080p up-rendering and offering enhanced features such as Trophies, Shareplay, Remote Play, Activity Feeds and Second Screen support for game manuals with PS App.
"Let the Hunt Begin!
You are Jango Fett, the most fearless bounty hunter in the galaxy, hired to capture a deranged Dark Jedi. Armed with an array of deadly weapons and skills, you’ll face off against galactic scum from the darkest corners of the Star Wars™ universe. For the galaxy’s most wanted-there is no place to hide."

Experience Star Wars™: Racer Revenge™ for PS2™ with full 1080p up-rendering and Trophies. Additional enhanced features include Shareplay, Remote Play, Activity Feeds and Second Screen support for game manuals with 'PS Vita' or PS App.
Fight to the finish at 600mph.
Race against 18 of the most aggressive, unforgiving Podracers in the universe, with supercharged A.I. keeping you in the thick of the action.
Experience blistering speed with all-new Podracers on 13 hair-raising courses across 5 worlds, to win your way to the Boonta Eve Classic.
Smash your opponents into twisted wreckage on your way to victory.

10005513.description:
Experience Wild Arms™ 2 originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
It’s about one world hanging in the balance. Where one hero must sacrifice his heart for peace. Where courage and fear, love and malice, heroes and villains go hand in hand. It’s power that exceeds human knowledge. It’s neither dream nor reality. It’s what legends are made of.

205924.name: ACT IT OUT! A Game of Charades
205924.description:
Play charades as you've never played it before!
'Act It Out! is a great party game, suitable for large groups of people and almost all situations' - IGN.
Choose from over 1,500 secret phrases to act out from categories including film, music and video games. More than just acting, you can even sing, draw or describe the hidden phrases!
PLAY WITH FRIENDS, PLAY WITH THE WORLD
Supports up to 8 players with just one DUALSHOCK®4 Wireless Controller. Compete against each other, work in teams, or play cooperatively. Discover 'Live Show', an innovative broadcast mode where you can play directly with your viewers.
A GREAT QUALITY EXPERIENCE
All content is playable in English (US/UK/Global), French, Italian, German, Spanish (Latin American/European) and Dutch. Catchy music, composed and recorded by BAFTA-nominee Dom Beken. Dazzling visuals running at 1080p/60fps. And it has cats.
ACT IT OUT! A Game of Charades is awesome with a group of friends, and perfect for a great game night!

10012825.description:
Mars Farce is a short, comedic, cinematic visual novel about “Mars Mission”…
Take a quick quiz to test your knowledge about Mars, and then unlock the funniest short movie you’ll ever watch about “Mars Mission”…
Enjoy the social media satire “Mars Farce”!

232541.name: Pato Box
232541.description:
Pato Box is an adventure/fighting game inspired by the “Punch-Out!!” series. Is a surreal boxing quest with a duck!
Test your reflexes as you fight your way through an evil corporation in search for retribution.
Uncover their deepest secrets by exploring thrilling 3d environments with a graphic novel/comic book art style.
Find the henchmen who took your dream away in an action-packed and fast-paced fights that will test you to the limit as a true boxing champion!
Will you chicken out or learn how to DUCK?
Features
-    Find the truth on Story Mode, a single player adventure filled with surprises and 3D environments as well as 2D boss fights!
-    Fight your way through Arcade Mode, defeat all the bosses as fast as possible one at a time or all in row with a special boss at the end!
-    Challenging and surreal 2D fights with a comic book art style.
-    Ducks... a lot of ducks!
Purchasing this content entitles you to both the PS4 ® system and “PS Vita” system versions!

10010951.name: Mister Mosquito
10010951.description:
Experience Mister Mosquito™ originally released on the PlayStation®2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
You are Mister Mosquito, an uninvited guest in the Yamada’s family home. You will need to drink as much of their blood as possible to survive the winter. They know you are in the house, and they plan to take you out.
Fly through and explore the 12 levels of the Yamada household, searching for victims. Use stealth or prepare for air combat as you do battle with human inhabitants. Watch the family’s relationship disintegrate as they take their irritation out on each other.

10005198.description:

Abe's peaceful retirement was shattered when visited by a vision from the Mudokon Spirit Guides. Abe™ learned the Magog Cartel was mining Necrum, the sacred Mudokon city of the dead, to collect bones to make super-addictive SoulStorm Brew.

The Force takes flight!
The galaxy is in turmoil as the events of Star Wars: Episode II rapidly approach. Adi Gallia embarks on behalf of the Jedi Council to investigate disturbances in the Karthakk system.
Over 20 planetary and deep space missions.
Single and Dual Player Action. Co-op options for all missions and additional two-player modes.
Unique mission scenarios. Straight up steep mountains, inside enormous bases, through asteroid fields circling small planets, and more!
Continuation of Star Wars Starfighter™ series. Graphics, effects and performance enhancements – along with over 40 new craft (capital ships, new flyable fighters and more,)
Force Powers in Flight. Lightning, Shields, Shock wave, Reflex.

10007620.name: Thrillville: Off the Rails
10007620.description:
Experience Thrillville: Off the Rails originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
Thrillville®: Off the Rails™ lives up to its name with 20 death-defying rides so outrageous, they inspire the same word from every park visitor who sees them: “WHOA!” Players build these incredible “WHOA Coasters” to leap from one track to another, launch through the air like cannonballs, blast through a burning ring of fire and more.
But the new fun doesn’t stop there. Off the Rails features 34 playable minigames, 15 all-new theme areas, over 40 thrill rides, a new story that ties together more than 100 missions, and social interaction with park guests that’s better than ever. The in-depth conversations both advance the plot and suggest better ways to manage the park. But is every guest to be trusted? and rides.and rides.
• Experience the visceral fun of interacting with a theme park you create.
Build and ride your own creations, talk and joke with all your guests, and play dozens of minigames
• Visit 15 themed areas, like Battleville, Winterville, Spaceville and Aeroville, all spread throughout five new parks
• Create 20 death-defying WHOA Coasters such as:
Hotrod Stunt - A nitro boost propels a car across a broken track
Pendulizer - A giant arm grabs the car just before a gap in the track, whips it around in a full circle, then sets it down on the other side
Escape Drop - The track holds the car stationary as it lifts itself from level ground to a full 90-degree drop. Then it lets go
• Distinguish your rides even more with enhanced customization options • Attach animatronics, flowers and flaming hoops to all of your coasters and rides
• Play 34 minigames – 14 new, 20 returning from the original Thrillville but with new levels

10013946.name: The Jumping Boy
10013946.description:
Get ready for an exciting trampoline adventure! Guide the boy as he jumps higher and higher, performing flips and tricks in the air. Each jump brings new opportunities to score big and discover surprises. The game is simple to play, but super fun. You'll want to keep coming back for more!
Aim carefully, time your jumps and watch the magic happen as you pull off amazing moves and earn bonus points. Each jump gives you a chance to unlock more fun and surprises. How high can you go?
The more you play, the more cool stuff you'll discover. Play for a few minutes or stay as long as you like - the bouncy fun never ends!
Cross-Save:
Pick up where you left off on PlayStation®4 at any time on PlayStation®5 by simply importing your save game from the PlayStation®4 version!
Check out this fun new game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team.
Jump for your life!

10006335.name: Mighty Math
10006335.description:
Mighty Math is a mind bending fusion of arcade survival and brain training all in one. Anyone can pick it up and play. It starts with a simple premise, collect a required set of numbers before all numbers run out to survive each round. As you collect numbers you will change the player value. You must maintain a player value between 0 and 9. If you go over or under this value range you will be instantly destroyed.
Although the game starts off with a simple concept, it contains endless rounds and ramps up in difficulty immensely. Survive as long as you can to set high scores to share with your friends!
Enjoy wild randomized runs with varying sets of numbers and traps for a unique experience each run!
Train your brain as you survive the mathematical onslaught in Mighty Math!

10004395.name: Syphon Filter (PS1)
10004395.description:
Experience Syphon Filter™ originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
Gabe Logan: guerrilla warfare expert, master marksman, and a man on a personal crusade to bring down an international terrorist ring and eliminate a deadly virus…
Syphon Filter exploded onto PlayStation® back in 1999 – now you can experience Logan’s classic first adventure all over again. Use stealth, reconnaissance, and extreme combat to trace the path of the Syphon Filter virus back to where it all began, and complete your mission by any means necessary…

This version does not support the PlayStation® console’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.

10012626.name: Jigsaw Puzzle Utopia
10012626.description:
Immerse yourself in the serene and satisfying world of Jigsaw Puzzle Utopia, a game designed for relaxation and mental engagement. This virtual jigsaw experience offers thousands of stunning puzzles with themes ranging from scenic landscapes and vibrant wildlife to intricate abstract art.
Choose your difficulty by adjusting the number of pieces, from beginner-friendly sets to expert-level challenges. The game’s intuitive interface makes placing pieces seamless, with features like automatic sorting, hints, and progress tracking. Enjoy soothing background music and customize your workspace for an even more immersive experience.
Jigsaw Puzzle Utopia caters to all puzzle lovers, providing endless hours of calm and joy.

10014187.name: Mighty Mouse Cheese Hunt
10014187.description: Mighty Mouse: Cheese Hunt is an action-adventure game where you play as a brave little mouse on an epic quest through magical lands in search of legendary cheese. Navigate treacherous cliffs, dodge traps, and battle cunning enemies to collect every precious piece. Gather upgrades, unlock new abilities, and uncover the secrets hidden in the shadow of a dark, mysterious castle.

10004136.name: Kargast
10004136.description:
“You just woke up but... oh, wait! This is not right! Everything seems weird and.. where did everyone go?”
Kargast is a dark narrative exploration game with light RPG elements and branching endings.
It tells a surreal and semi-satirical story of an unwell child on the brink of death,
and his adventures through his surreal, cryptic surroundings..
You must guide him through a place of torment,
confront the unknown and make vital choices along the way. Travel
through dark and mysterious environments with your shiny little
companion, fight your way through dozens of odd and malformed creatures,
and uncover what strange truths lay hidden before it’s too late.
Features:
Explore strange worlds with odd inhabitants.
Lite-RPG elements and strange battles.
Authentic synthwave soundtrack that fits the atmosphere.
Original art with thoughtfully crafted locations.
A naive protagonist.
The ability to make friends, unlike real life.
This product entitles you to download both the digital PS4™ version and the digital PS5™ version of this game.
If you already own the PS4™ version of this game, you can get the PS5™ digital version at no extra cost and you do not need to purchase this product. Owners of a PS4™ disc copy must insert it into the PS5™ every time they want to download or play the PS5™ digital version. PS4™ game disc owners who buy the PS5™ Digital Edition disc-free console will not be able to get the PS5™ version at no extra cost.

10012353.name: Bounce Journey
10012353.description:
Embark on an incredible journey through a world filled with adventure and challenges as a cute bouncing ball in "Bounce Journey". This charming platformer game set in a cartoonish universe will have you jumping, rolling, and fighting your way through levels to rescue your friends and defeat your enemies.
As you progress through the game, you'll face increasingly difficult obstacles and enemies that will test your skills and reflexes.
With its colorful graphics, catchy soundtrack, and addictive gameplay, "Bounce Journey" is a delightful adventure that is sure to provide hours of fun for players of all ages.

10012171.name: Pixicharm - Dinoluship
10012171.description: Pick your favorite dino and race through an endless, fun level! Jump over obstacles, collect meat and veggies, and spit fire to clear your path. Easy controls and colorful graphics make this game perfect for kids! How long can your dino run?

10001742.name: Zombies ruined my day
10001742.description:
This is the story of how the best day of your life can become a nightmare full of zombies. Survive in a hostile environment using all sorts of weapons. Defend your position with barricades, blow up groups of zombies with grenades, sweep the area away with a Gatling and more! All in a fully action packed game with colorful backgrounds and fearsome monsters. Show us that you're more than a snack for zombies!
Features
- 27 challenging levels across 3 distinct zones
- 6 zombie types and 3 huge bosses
- 8 weapons to unlock
- Colorful cartoony graphics
- And an amusing background story!

10002685.name: Catie in MeowmeowLand
10002685.description:
Catie in MeowmeowLand is a beautiful traditional point-and-click adventure game set in a bizarre world of cats and ludicrous characters.
As Catie follows a strange white cat in her garden she suddenly finds herself in a mysterious world of MeowmeowLand, where she has to undergo a journey to find her way back home. Your task is to help Catie get there!
* MeowmeowLand is a bizarre world where you find the most unexpected characters in even more unpredictable situations
* As you help Catie solve all kinds of original puzzles, be ready to face absurdly comical situations
* Play through over 24 beautiful 2D hand-drawn sceneries, see more than 100 funny characters and more than 2 hours of charmingly crafted 2D animations
* Listen to original recorded comical voices of all characters and composed music
* Instead of reading traditional dull text boxes all characters communicate through comic bubbles filled with amusing line art
Supported using public funding by Slovak Arts Council

10008475.name: Do Not Crash
10008475.description: Drive your car to avoid obstacles and cars chasing you. Crash the cars and collect coins to buy a new whip.

10005704.name: Hot Tentacles Shooter
10005704.description:
This product entitles you to download both the digital PS4™ version and the digital PS5™ version of this game.
Take control of the drop ship in this space adventure and free all the girls from spooky alien tentacles!
Hot Tentacles Shooter combines the immediate fun typical of shoot’em arcade up with an irresistible strongly ecchi vibe!
Alish is the last hope for a platoon of space warriors.
During a reconnaissance mission, your allies were captured by giant alien tentacles and only you can help them.
Live with Sofia aboard a spaceship and repel the alien threat through 20 levels!
Features:
* Free 20 beautiful girls from the clutches of big tentacles!
* Unlock new outfits for Sofia!
* A beautiful Pixel Art awaits in this game!
* Space soundtrack!
* Arcade action: Shoot, dodge and use devastating power-ups!
* Test yourself against 3 fearsome bosses!
* Collect all the girls’ portraits!
If you already own the PS4™ version of this game, you can get the PS5™ digital version at no extra cost and you do not need to purchase this product. Owners of a PS4™ disc copy must insert it into the PS5™ every time they want to download or play the PS5™ digital version. PS4™ game disc owners who buy the PS5™ Digital Edition disc-free console will not be able to get the PS5™ version at no extra cost.

10006329.name: The Monkey P
10006329.description: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Eat bananas with the main hero of the game The Moneky P and eat all the bananas in the world!

10013984.name: Ultimate Zombie Defense
10013984.description:
Ultimate Zombie Defense is a Top-down Survival Horror set in the suburbs of a once quiet city, in the heart of continental Europe. The city and the surrounding 250km landmass have been sealed off in an attempt to curtail the outbreak, although sadly all attempts have failed, until now.
You are elite member of the military dropped into this plagued location and have only one mission: Locate and destroy the source of the infection.
Well, what are you waiting for? Get to it, Soldier!
FEATURES
1. Base Building
An extensive base building system where you may place objects such as chain link fences, sandbags, barbed wire, concrete barriers, turrets, mines, fog lights and other military-grade components!
2. Apocalyptic Arsenal
Apocalypse proof weapon selection from the classic pump shotgun to the flamethrower, grenade launcher, mini-gun and many, many more!
Epic Slow-mo that will trigger during your most impressive moments
Unique Boss fights to challenge even the most seasoned zombie slayers
Metal music mayhem - Rock out whilst laying waste to hordes of the undead!
3. Character Progression
Choose between 8 unique characters to battle the army of the dead
4. A lof of ZOMBIES!
A variety of infected including more than 12 Unique monster types

10014165.name: Pixicharm - Starry Blast
10014165.description: Pilot a starship in a colorful galaxy! Blast waves of mischievous cosmic critters in this action-packed adventure. With adorable visuals and simple controls, it’s perfect for players of all ages seeking intergalactic fun!

10011686.name: Pixicharm - Tiny Speedster
10011686.description: Hop into the driver's seat in "Tiny Speedster"! Choose one of three adorable cars and hit the track. Your car will zoom along at a constant speed while you focus on collecting as many shiny coins as possible and avoiding obstacles in your path. Can you gather all the coins and become the ultimate Tiny Speedster?

10016926.name: Word Quest Pirates
10016926.description: Set sail on a thrilling puzzle adventure where the seas are filled with hidden words and untold treasures. In Word Quest: Pirates, you’ll solve exciting word searches to unlock treasure chests, outsmart rival pirates, and uncover legendary loot. With each level, the challenge grows as you chart your way across mysterious islands and ancient maps. Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate pirate word master?

10011922.name: Pixicharm - Shurikoo Sprint
10011922.description: Embark on an exhilarating adventure with the nimble ninja in Shurikoo Sprint! Guide your ninja through challenging paths, swiftly throwing shurikens to defeat roaming monsters. With straightforward controls and fast-paced action, Shurikoo Sprint offers a thrilling challenge that's easy to pick up and play. Can you dash past all obstacles and emerge victorious in this action-packed sprint? Join the fun and test your skills in Shurikoo Sprint!

10012570.name: Pixicharm - Tiny Starfighters
10012570.description: Embark on an exciting space adventure where you take control of a spaceship and battle endless waves of enemies across the galaxy. Collect coins as you blast through your foes and unlock new, powerful ships to enhance your journey. With every wave, the challenge intensifies—how long can you survive the cosmic chaos? Prepare to gear up and zap your way to victory!

10005088.name: Super Kids Racing - Snow Edition
10005088.publisher: YASH FUTURE TECH SOLUTIONS PVT LTD
10005088.description:
Super Kids Racing : Snow Edition offers wide variety of challenges with many different types of vehicles to choose from. Players will love to complete these challenges with their friends in split-screen multiplayer mode.
Get ready for ultimate racing adventure with your friends and family.
Features
1. There are 10 different challenges in the game with minimum 3 laps in each level.
2. 20 different types of vehicles to play within the game.
3. Suitable for all age group. Friends and family will enjoy playing this game.
4. Multi-language support in the game.
5. Split screen multiplayer mode enables player to play with their friends and family.
Get Ready to race.........

10016562.name: Pixicharm - Cavrielle
10016562.description: Run, jump, and react fast! Cavrielle is an endless arcade-style runner where one brave girl dives into a dangerous cave full of coins, traps, and surprises. Easy to play, hard to master — perfect for quick sessions and high-score chases.

10015747.name: Pixicharm - TuttiRun
10015747.description:
In TuttiRun, you play as a masked mystery racer speeding through vibrant worlds filled with juicy strawberries and tricky traps. Jump your way through the chaos and keep the run going—how far can you get before it’s game over?
A colorful, fast-paced adventure that’s easy to pick up and hard to put down!

10005361.name: Mini Car Racing 2
10005361.description:
Race around in tiny vehicles in a giant household and experience amazing arcade fun races with your friends up to four players or race alone and hunt the next best time in 16 different race tracks! Complete championships to unlock new different tracks or race the arcade mode. Play with up to four friends in splitscreen and have a fun race experience! Race On!
Features:
- Different tiny vehicles
- 16 Tracks
- Different game modes: Arcade, Timetrail and championship
- Splitscreen mode up to 4 players

10016485.name: Pixicharm - Chromastronaut
10016485.description:
Welcome to Blaster Orbit, a high-speed pixel-art arcade shooter where survival and score go hand-in-hand.
Pilot your ship through an endless cosmic battlefield filled with hostile alien fleets, deadly projectiles, and shimmering coins waiting to be grabbed. Dodge, blast, and weave your way through beautifully animated retro space environments while racking up high scores.
Switch between precise shooting and evasive flying as you power up your ship, collect health, and chase orbiting coins for massive score boosts. With smooth controls, vibrant visuals, and non-stop action, Blaster Orbit brings back the thrill of classic shoot-'em-ups—with a modern endless twist.
How long can you survive the orbit?

10014595.name: Pixicharm – Frost Ascent
10014595.description: Brave the icy heights in Frost Ascent! Climb frozen ropes, dodge deadly icicle spikes, and collect golden coins as you ascend a treacherous snowy mountain. Test your reflexes in this fast-paced arcade challenge and see how high you can go!

10012312.name: Pixicharm - Fruboom
10012312.description: Toss fruits to find their matching pairs! As you play, the fruits change color and become trickier to match, adding an exciting challenge. Designed with young players in mind, it’s a simple, kid-friendly experience perfect for even the littlest hands. Bright visuals and easy-to-understand gameplay make it a joyful adventure for all ages!

10014659.name: Pixicharm - Jack-O-Fall
10014659.description: Guide a tumbling pumpkin through the night! Dodge spooky ghosts and crafty crows while collecting shiny coins to rack up your score. How long can you keep falling in this fast-paced, arcade-style challenge?

10016201.name: Pixicharm - Kunai Zone
10016201.description:
In Kunai Zone, you're a lone fighter locked in an endless arena where only precision matters. Five monsters line up above — but you can only strike the one that matches the shape on your head. React fast, throw your kunai, and score big!
Hit the right target to earn points. Strike the wrong one and lose some. With each mistake, you edge closer to defeat — so stay sharp and trust your reflexes.
A fast-paced, pixel-perfect challenge of pattern recognition and ninja focus!

10015896.name: Pixicharm - Majestreats
10015896.description:
In Majestreats, you play as a hungry holiday princess on a royal quest for delicious treats! Dash through sunny beaches and resort paths, collecting burgers, ice cream, and chocolate — but watch out for the pesky mosquitoes! Each bite will cost you precious points, so stay sharp and keep those snacks coming.
A lighthearted, fast-paced adventure full of yummy fun and royal flair!

10016527.name: Pixicharm - Polar Outta Place
10016527.description:
Slide into the fiery chaos in Polar Outta Place, an endless runner where you're a very lost polar bear dashing through molten mayhem. Dodge slimes, leap over fire pits, and snatch up shiny coins—all while trying not to become a toasted marshmallow.
With simple controls, fast-paced action, and a ridiculous setting, this is one run you won’t forget. Stay cool, move fast, and prove that even the most out-of-place bear can beat the heat!

10016347.name: Pixicharm - Spartunex
10016347.description:
In Spartunex, you're a space pilot on a mission to blast through waves of enemies. Defeat the required number in each stage to move forward — but stay sharp!
With simple controls, fast action, and retro pixel vibes, it’s a fun, no-fuss arcade shooter that’s all about dodging, blasting, and chasing high scores.

10015847.name: Pixicharm - Flindlehop
10015847.description:
In Flindlehop, join a joyful crew of forest critters as they sprint endlessly through a golden autumn forest. Collect shiny coins, dodge mischievous ghosts, flutter past birds, and bounce around floating balloons in this fast-paced, feel-good adventure! How far can you go before the forest says stop?
A cozy, colorful runner for all ages—easy to pick up, hard to put down!

10008766.name: Whispike Survivors - Sword of the Necromancer
10008766.description:
Whispike Survivors blends two trendy game genres: horde survivor and farm simulator.
Features:
-  Defeat hordes of enemies to make your Whispike stronger.
- Use the seeds that Whispikes drop when dying to grow them in your Whispike farm and make even stronger hybrids!
- Turn your foes into manure to accelerate the Whispike's growth!
In this game you will control one of Sword of the Necromancer's monsters and make it fight other critters to make it the strongest! Were you defeated? Don't worry! You can take your last monster's seed, plant it and get it back...
Only "adult" Whispikes are eligible to fight, so you will have to wait and take care of your farm until they grow (or play with a default one in the meantime). Also, you might not get exactly what you expect: by planting seeds in neighboring slots you can get hybrids that combine the original seeds' attributes!
This product entitles you to download both the digital PS4® version and the digital PS5® version of this game.

227202.name: Revenant Saga
227202.description:
This product entitles you to download the digital versions of this game for PS5🄬, PS4®, PS3™and PlayStation®Vita.
Become a Revenant and find the truth beyond revenge in this gothic fantasy RPG with stunning 3D battles!
After being turned into an immortal being known as a 'Revenant' and learning of the existence of a demon within him, Albert sets out on a journey to make the person who did this to him pay with their very life. However, as he runs into others along the way dealing with their own figurative demons, what is the answer he finds...?
Boasting a story that blurs the lines between good and evil, and plenty of content to go around, this is one title not to be missed! This includes a variety of unique subquests, in-battle transformation systems, as well as a weapon forging system allowing players to make entirely unique weapons as they battle in turn-based battles with 3D animation!

10015740.name: Chimpanzini Bananini
10015740.description: Slide left, slide right – catch as many bananas as you can in Chimpanzini Bananini, a fast-paced meme-fueled arcade game. Play as the internet’s favorite chimp. How long can you keep up the monkey business?

10001824.name: Mind Maze
10001824.description:
Mind Maze is a competitive logic puzzle game where you try to capture territory on the board.
Place walls, build a maze, and capture tiles. Don't let any dead ends appear, or your opponent will capture them.
Plan your moves in advance, develop a strategy, and set logic traps for your opponent. Get sneaky - force your opponent to make a mistake and cover the board with an unstoppable landslide that will carry you to victory.
Play the solo campaign or compete with other players in hotseat mode.

10011294.name: Caretaker
10011294.description:
You’re an investigative journalist who is “hungry” for a flashy news story. You heard the news of one caretaker in this now abandoned industrial facility who has gone insane and killed all of his co-workers. Now, the urban legend is that this “caretaker” has returned to this industrial facility and people has seen this “monster back to life”. You want to uncover this myth. You are hungry for truth and maybe this caretake is hungry for something else.
In Caretaker, you play as investigative journalist Joe Salinger, who is desperate for a flashy news story. He has watched the news of one caretaker in this industrial facility who has gone insane and killed all of his co-workers. Now, the urban legend is that this “caretaker” has returned to this industrial facility and people has seen this “monster back to life”. Joe Salinger wants to uncover this myth. While he explores the facility, we finds out the psychological journey of this “caretaker” and he learns how he reached this level of “no return” and became criminally insane over the course of time.

222246.name: Dead Island Retro Revenge
222246.description:
Time for some 16-bit retro revenge! Hell-bent on saving his cat, Max must carve a bloody path through a zombie-infested California, tearing his way through hordes of the undead, battalions of corrupt soldiers, and a slew of evil-minded ex-cons. Pull off crazy combos, collect power-ups, wield super weapons, and unleash insane magic attacks as you fight to become the amazing 16-bit side-scrolling hero you've always believed yourself to be!
1 player
DUALSHOCK®4

10014223.name: Sprint for Survival
10014223.description:
In Sprint for Survival, there’s no time to ask questions. You wake up in the dark, the forest is alive, and they’re already coming. Your only option? Move forward. Don’t stop. Don’t think.
Dodge, shoot, heal, repeat. Every step is earned, every meter counts, and every shadow hides something worse than the last.
You won't survive forever — but you might just survive a little longer.

234535.name: Post War Dreams
234535.publisher: Kingstill International Software Services ltd (dba KISS)
234535.description:
Post War Dreams is a 2.5D Story-Rich, Side Scrolling Action Game, set in the wasteland of USA, plagued with constant war. Following the collapse of the economy, government, and society, you must brave heavily armed militia, lawless gangs, dangerous streets, desolate buildings and underground bunkers on your quest to escape this post-apocalyptic wasteland alive. The road to a new life is paved with danger, hope and constant reminders of everything that’s been lost.
1 player

All rights reserved by Kiss Publishing LTD.

10012038.name: Forest Cafe Simulator
10012038.description:
It's time to take care of cute animals and build a cozy cafe for them in a forest clearing. Get everything ready for the reception. Add various tasty dishes and drinks to the menu.
Set the work so that no one has to wait in line for too long, or the animals will get upset. Hire and train staff. Make your cafe the most popular in the forest!
Cross-Save:
Pick up where you left off on PlayStation®4 at any time on PlayStation®5 by simply importing your save game from the PlayStation®4 version!
Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team.
Get ready to meet your little friends at the Forest Café.

10012533.name: Honey Farm Simulator
10012533.description:
Bees are such cute creatures, but can you build a real business empire making and selling honey? It all seems so simple. Give it a try.
Build beehives, raise families of bees and plant new crops to get unusual varieties of honey.
Don't forget to keep your customers happy and coming back for more.
This is the only way to grow and reach new heights in this exciting business!
Cross-Save:
Pick up where you left off on PlayStation®4 at any time on PlayStation®5 by simply importing your save game from the PlayStation®4 version!
Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team.
Finger-licking good game to take your first steps in the real business.

10010371.name: Sky Survivors
10010371.description:
Sky Survivors is an arena shooter roguelite. Choose from a variety of skills, unlock unique characters and weapons. Build «stairway to heaven» — a sky tower, each floor of which gives your character a unique bonus. Create your own overpowered build to survive against hordes of monsters!
Features:
■ Auto-aim mode.
■ Over 100 different skills to choose from.
■ «Stairway to Heaven» — each floor has its own unique bonuses.
■ Unique weapons that completely change your playstyle.
■ Diverse characters with unique abilities.
■ Multiple game modes allow you to choose the playstyle to your liking.

10015885.name: Br Br Patapim
10015885.description:
Br Br Patapim is not just a game – it's a brainrot experience.
Slide left, slide right – dodge failure with pure reflex and questionable sanity. Every success pumps your score. Every miss nukes it. Meme sounds scream in the background. Chaos is constant. Logic is gone.
Easy to pick up. Impossible to explain.
This is Br Br Patapim.

216182.name: Downwell
216182.description:
Downwell is a curious game about a young person venturing down a well in search of untold treasures with only his Gunboots for protection. Make your way further and further down into the darkness filled with nasty creatures and mysterious secrets to collect the spectacular red gems scattered about the rocks.
Purchasing this content entitles you to both the PS4™ system and “PS Vita” system versions!
1 player
300MB minimum save size

720p HD Video Output

232989.name: Sea of Solitude
232989.description:
When humans get too lonely, they turn into monsters… Set sail across a beautiful and evolving world of darkness and light, and discover what it means to be human.
KEY FEATURES
- AN EMOTIONAL JOURNEY
Sea of Solitude embarks players on a nuanced and intimate action-adventure, where players must guide Kay through her Sea of Solitude, in this touching tale of darkness and light.
- A METAPHORICAL WORLD
Water levels rise and fall to reflect Kay's own state of mind, transforming the flooded city landscape into new areas for the player to explore, with new challenges to face.
- FACE THE MONSTERS WITHIN
Encounter fantastical creatures, solve puzzles, and rid the world of tainted memories. Meet a variety of beautiful and terrifying monsters, each with their own struggles of loneliness to tell.
Remote Play requires PS Vita system and sufficiently robust Wi-Fi connection.
1 player
