10010598.name: Overdrive Blaster
10010598.description:
In this retro-style arcade game, you have to shoot the monsters to gather colored spheres! Get three of the same color in a row to get a weapon upgrade! Upgrade all three colors to win!
This product entitles you to download both the digital PS4® version and the digital PS5® version of this game.
If you already own the PS4® version of this game, you can get the PS5® digital version at no extra cost and you do not need to purchase this product. Owners of a PS4® disc copy must insert it into the PS5® every time they want to download or play the PS5® digital version. PS4® game disc owners who buy the PS5® Digital Edition disc-free console will not be able to get the PS5® version at no extra cost.

232184.name: Circuits
232184.description:
Simple in concept, but very challenging and rewarding, Circuits is a musical puzzle game that requires careful listening to complete each level. The goal of Circuits: to piece together the different parts of a song. Sounds easy, but maybe it's not...
As we love music, we wanted to make a game that gives the player an insight into how music is created and makes listening the core part of the experience. Packed with beautifullly designed minimal graphics, to not disturb the focus of the game, and 25 different songs for the player to reconstruct. So if you like music, you will like Circuits .
Features:
* Engaging gameplay that gives an insight into music creation for players
* A soundtrack mix of electronic ambient,dubstep, and epic orchestra composed by David García (Deadlight, Rime...)
* Beautiful minimal design
* And a Turbo Mode!

10005083.name: Rooten
10005083.description:
When you arrived at the research station, no one met you. The helicopter that brought you here won't return for at least several days. You're trapped here alone, with no contact to the outside world. And there is only IT for many kilometers around. The Forest.
There is not a single living soul around, but something else hides in the darkness. A strange, inhuman creature lurks among the roots of the trees. It knows you're here. And for the first time in a long, long time, it has decided to come out.
▪ The world of the game has a life of its own. Events here will happen regardless of your presence.
▪ A dense dark atmosphere.
▪ Hand-drawn graphics combines 2d and 3d.
▪ Uncover the secrets of the Forest and the mystery of the station staff's disappearance.
▪ Explore the many locations of the Forest. But remember: in the Forest, curiosity can be dangerous.

234039.name: One Night Stand
234039.description:
This product entitles you to download both the digital PS4™ version and the digital PS5™ version of this game.
In One Night Stand, explore the stranger’s bedroom and seek out clues to identify who she is and what brought you both together.
You may resort to some unusual methods to find the answers you’re looking for, but try not to prod and pry too much – a nosy guest quickly becomes an unwanted one!
Will you stay and explore your relationship with this stranger, or will you escape when the opportunity presents itself? With 12 unique endings to discover, can you keep up the act long enough to find out what really happened?
Features:
- Life-like rotoscope animations and hand-drawn artwork
- An interactive story where your choices matter
- 12 different endings that reveal new insights into what really happened
- An original soundtrack
If you already own the PS4™ version of this game, you can get the PS5™ digital version at no extra cost and you do not need to purchase this product. Owners of a PS4™ disc copy must insert it into the PS5™ every time they want to download or play the PS5™ digital version. PS4™ game disc owners who buy the PS5™ Digital Edition disc-free console will not be able to get the PS5™ version at no extra cost.

10009864.name: Space Papers: Planet's Border
10009864.description:
Become the best police officer of the intergalactic patrol, watch over the planet's border and protect the galaxy. Analyze papers from all types of aliens and check their luggage!
Parasites are the main galactic threat and will do anything for universal domination. How good are you at identifying them? Remember that the goal is to keep the galactic airport's security and find criminal parasites to arrest them!
Your main objective is to check the traveler's passports and discover dangerous objects they can use, like bananas... THAT'S RIGHT, BANANAS!! Our lives depend on checking the aliens' papers, X-rays and luggage! The more enemies you find on the planet's border, the more money you'll get to upgrade your equipment.
Features:
- become a real border patrol officer!
- carefully check the documents of people traveling because they might be fake!
- find false data on documents and send unauthorized people home
- scan travelers using special machines and find forbidden items under their clothes or in suitcases
- get a daily target of correctly checked travelers and earn rewards
- upgrade your machines to reduce scanning time and increase the number of rewards per traveler
- complete all levels with different objectives while avoiding activities that cause you to fail the level. Stay focused and don't make any mistakes!
- watch the levels with a storyline and see what happens!
Grab your space suit, prepare your intergalactic equipment, and secure the planet's border!

10009582.name: Halloween Puzzle
10009582.publisher: ERIK GAMES YAZILIM OYUN TEKNOLOJILERI TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
10009582.description:
Immerse yourself in a dark and mysterious world as you explore the enchanting atmosphere of Halloween in this classic card matching game. With four distinct difficulty levels to choose from – Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert – get ready for a thrilling adventure.
Amongst the cards featuring ghosts, witches, cauldrons, and more, you'll need to exercise your memory and concentration to uncover the perfect matches. You can start with Easy for a pleasant introduction, but true mastery awaits you in the challenging Expert mode.
The Halloween ambiance will captivate you at every level, adding an extra layer of excitement to the game. With spooky themes and mind-bending pairings, this game will provide hours of fun for you and your friends. Flip the cards, make the matches, and unveil the secrets of this mystical world

10011390.name: Cubic Riders
10011390.description: A fast-paced racing game where you can test your skills and see how you perform on the track. You have to be really fast and make decisions in milliseconds. Avoid all the obstacles and become number one! Customize your Cubics to win in style!

10012359.name: Pirate Treasure: Island of Mazes
10012359.description:
Pirate Treasure: Island of Mazes is a wonderful puzzle game where you need to help pirates get out of a wretched maze. There are a plethora of puzzles to choose from, so you will end up having a whole bunch of fun all the time.
Since there are dozens of levels to choose from, you always get to enjoy a unique and immersive game experience. Plus, you can test your puzzle solving skills and improve them as you go along. Check it out for yourself today!
Features:
- Dozens of levels to play through
- Beautiful pirate theme
- Engaging, fun gameplay
- Lots of replay value

10011436.name: Poopy Time
10011436.description: Gather and eat as much food as you can until you can't stand it anymore. Find a secluded corner and show everyone what you've got. Just don't get caught by the guards!

10016327.name: Dot Connect
10016327.description:
Get ready to dive into a world of logic and flow with Dot Connect, a modern puzzle game designed to challenge your brain and keep you entertained for hours!
Connect the dots, avoid obstacles, and fill the grid in over 1280 hand-crafted levels. Each stage offers a unique challenge as you progress through beautifully designed worlds – from minimalist grids to increasingly complex mazes.
With its sleek visuals, smooth animations, and addictive gameplay, Dot Connect is the perfect game for puzzle lovers of all ages. Whether you're solving a quick level on the go or tackling a tough challenge, there's always a new connection to make.
Key Features:
1280 levels of addictive puzzle-solving fun
Multiple visual worlds with increasing difficulty
Relaxing yet challenging flow-based gameplay
Smooth controls and modern design
Great for quick sessions or deep focus

232260.name: FullBlast
232260.description:
Try to take in as much as you can, when you have the time though. Being a shmup, it’s not just an alien menace you have to worry about, but their projectiles you’ll need to dodge if you hope to survive! Across the game’s 12 random levels, humanity is on the verge of extinction due to an alien invasion and it just so happens, you're the last hope to save the world. So, get ready to take flight and let loose, because those aliens are not going to shoot themselves. Humanity’s retaliation starts here!
Features:
* Story campaign of 12 levels
* 4 Mini bosses and 3 Mega bosses
* 3 Difficulty levels
* Mission system and leaderboards
* Gorgeous 3D graphics
* Power-ups and power-downs (be careful of what you pick!!)
* Heavy metal sound track
This Cross-Buy product entitles you to download both PS4™ and PS Vita versions.

10004469.name: Ultimate ADOM  - Caverns of Chaos
10004469.description:
After over 25 years, here comes the official sequel to classic ADOM.
Experience the modern reimagining of a traditional roguelike dungeon-crawling classic. Endless procedurally generated dungeons, countless monsters, grafting, crafting and a vast amount of skill trees and items allow for unlimited replayability.
DELVE INTO THE LORE
Evil has been vanquished. Peace has returned to Ancardia, and the peasants dare to dream once more of prosperity. Seven very different factions vie for control over the cataclysmic aftermath left behind by Andor Drakon’s defeat. And somewhere, deep down in an inhospitable cave, ChAoS is stirring again.
Pick up your blade, prepare your spells, check your daggers and ready your bow, for you are about to enter the ominous Caverns of Chaos. Choose your allegiance carefully, for you are nothing more than an expendable asset to the masters you choose.
Fight for a mercenary's glory and purse, for the justice of a folk in decline, for the light of purity or even for ChAoS itself. Every choice you make will determine how you approach the ever-changing Caverns of Chaos before you.
CLASSIC ROGUELIKE VIRTUES MEET MODERN FEATURES
Endless procedurally generated dungeons, countless monsters, items and a grand selection of very different skills allow for unlimited replayability.
Interactive surroundings! Topple braziers, push coffins, smash doors or turn them into wooden golems to (hopefully) serve your bidding.
Choose or toggle between graphic mode and traditional ASCII at any time. Toggle between 3D mode and top down view, in ASCII or in the graphic mode.
Intuitive control system will get rid of the need to memorize hundreds of keys. Though you can still do so, if you're into that. We are not judging.
UNRIVALED COMPLEXITY AND CONTENT
A great variety of classes, genders, races and allegiances to choose from allow for extensive build diversity and change the way the game challenges you. NPCs will react differently, new quests will be open to you and the world may change completely based on your decisions.
A deep magic system with several unique schools of magic and over 100 of spells to choose from, ranging from summoning demons to animating the very walls of the dungeon to aid you - the possibilities are endless.
Over 80 skill trees and dozens of secret skills trees that are only waiting to be unlocked.
A stealth system introduces a totally new way of playing the game: Instead of hacking or blasting all opposition to pieces you now can sneak past adversaries and avoid conflict.
Turn yourself into an abomination and graft your enemies’ body parts on yourself. They won’t need them anymore, and what's better than wielding two swords? Two swords and an axe to harvest more body parts than ever before.
CHALLENGING AND UNCOMPROMISING, YET REWARDING
Countless options of how to tackle the dungeons awaiting you. Befriend or tame creatures, slay monsters, delve deeper or keep exploring and expanding the cavern levels you have already found. Over 200 different foes await, each requiring matching tactics.
"Dying is part of the fun" - Each death is permanent. Your progress however will allow continuous improvement of future characters.

233207.name: Drowning
233207.description: Drowning is a short game about a boy who quickly discovers he has depression in his earlier years of high school. Walk through a variety of beautiful low-poly environments as a story unfolds about how he learns to live with his inner demon. You will play in the eyes of a young boy starting out high school in year 7, and play through his following years, where he learns that living with depression is like living with someone trying to put you down all the time. Walk through all the beautiful environments with a lovely soundtrack that suits the current mood of the game, and find all the hidden endings.

227136.name: Energy Balance
227136.description:
During a mission your spaceship encounters an unknown anomaly and all systems fail. You have to balance the energy in order to get them running again and to get home safely.
Energy Balance is a number puzzle. You have to swap power units in such a way that their sums form correct chains both vertically and horizontally. The game is easy to learn, but very hard to master. So, are you ready to peep under the hood of an alien spaceship?

10012347.name: Jim’s Adventure
10012347.description:
Jim's Adventure is a game where you need to follow Jim, the Native American in an exciting and challenging adventure. He is exploring a large world filled with perils, ranging from various creatures to obstacles, all trying to stop him. There are a multitude of levels to complete and Jim has a very limited amount of lives.
Every level has its fair share of challenges, and there are multiple game worlds ranging from haunted forests to deserts, caves and many others.
Features:
100+ challenging levels
Immersive, fast paced and fun gameplay
Exciting platformer
Beautiful visuals
Avoid creatures and obstacles

232137.name: Shadow of Loot Box
232137.description:
If you always thought that there were too few loot boxes in other games, this game is for you!
Shadow of Loot Box is an attempt to present what video games can become in the near future. Each level of this shooter is a reference to a popular trend in the modern game development industry. Will you be able to overcome the thorny path full of microtransactions, loot boxes and bugs, resisting the temptation to use the in-game store?
Key features:
* Loot Boxes.
* More Loot Boxes!
* Micropayments.
* Pre-Pre-Early Access.
* Cut content.
* Procedurally Generated Quests.
* Towers and Outposts.
* 16 levels to explore with different topics
* 4 bosses
* And much more!

10015452.name: Tralalero Tralala Jumper
10015452.description: A shark. A wall. A dodge. A meme. Swipe, switch, and laugh as the viral "Tralalero Tralala" sound follows your every move. No pressure. Just pure meme-powered chaos.

10013945.name: Spin Around
10013945.description:
Spin the ladder, choose your path, and crash into everything around you! Each swing opens up wild new possibilities, keeping the action non-stop and exciting. Simple to learn, but endlessly fun, this is a game you'll want to play again and again.
Find the best spin and let the mayhem begin! One perfect move can set off a massive chain of destruction. Spot clever options to see how far and how long you can keep smashing forward!
Play forever by uncovering patterns, grabbing rewards, boosting your power, and discovering secret treasures as you break through each level!
Cross-Save:
Pick up where you left off on PlayStation®4 at any time on PlayStation®5 by simply importing your save game from the PlayStation®4 version!
Check out this fun new game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team.
Destroy everything around you!

10011761.name: Colorama Cubes
10011761.description: Don't hurry. Just look at the board, try to find the best paths and solve each puzzle!

10016253.name: Italian Brainrot
10016253.description: Can you spot the brainrot? Dive into the world of Italian Brainrot, where your only tool is a magnifying glass. Find the right character, score a point, and keep going. Fast, funny, and addictive — how high can you go?

10013465.name: Boomerang Of Destruction
10013465.description:
Learn to use the boomerang - one of the best and most unique weapons available. Feel the awesome experience and use it for your victories!
Throw the boomerang at your enemies, trying to choose the best trajectory and speed to cause the most damage. You will see just how dangerous this weapon can be.
Complete all the levels with this wonderful tool of war and become the most skilled boomerang warrior in the world. Just throw it again and again. It will return to its master each time.
Cross save:
Pick up where you left off on PlayStation®4 at any time on PlayStation®5 by simply importing your save game from the PlayStation®4 version!
Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team.
Feel the way our ancestors fought!

10012625.name: Ramp Bike Racing
10012625.description:
Get ready for an adrenaline-charged adventure with Ramp Bike Racing! Hop on your bike and navigate towering mega ramps that challenge your skill and push your limits. Perform daring stunts as you tackle impossible tracks and gravity-defying jumps. Conquer a range of obstacles, from zig-zag paths to blazing fire-lit tracks, all while experiencing addictive, edge-of-your-seat gameplay.
Unlock powerful bikes and race through exhilarating loops and complex puzzle tracks that test your racing and problem-solving abilities. Take on uniquely crafted courses that demand precision and boldness.
Are you prepared to defy the odds, master the ramps, and claim your title as the ultimate race champion?

10014126.name: Campfire of Oasis 2
10014126.description:
The desert night is calm, the fire flickers, and your loyal dog is by your side. In Campfire Oasis 2, you embark on a cozy adventure. Your companion searches the surroundings for wood, and you gather what is found. Every bundle strengthens the fire at the heart of your camp, turning a quiet night into a safe haven of warmth.
At the same time, each piece collected also provides food, deepening the bond between you and your dog. The more you gather, the more the campfire grows, and the stronger your friendship becomes.
The focus of Campfire Oasis 2 is relaxation. There are no enemies, no danger, no stress—just you, your companion, and the steady rhythm of collecting. The more you play, the more the campfire becomes a beacon in the desert night. Watch it grow brighter and stronger as your loyal friend returns again and again with supplies.
Campfire Oasis 2 continues the spirit of the first game with a familiar, minimalistic experience while placing greater emphasis on your dog’s role as both helper and companion. A peaceful setting, simple progression, and the comforting presence of your loyal friend define the atmosphere of the game.

10016357.name: Chiro Gravitas
10016357.description:
"ChiroGravitas
The goal of the game:
1) Reach the goal number of field cells under the control of black cores. When the number is permissible (indicated next to each), 'OK' is written under the core;
and
2) Move 10 or more particles which orbit the cores to the area of influence of the main black core (selected randomly each time). When there are 10 or more particles, '!!' is written under the core.
The conditions are not checked by the game automatically. The left and right directional buttons switch available levels regardless of the level objectives.
Controls:
Press touch pad - influence particles
Hold LT and press touch pad - influence cores
Square button - show/hide core-controlled cells
Triangle button - restart
R2 - show/hide help
You control a spacecraft that can shoot 4 different weapons (collectable as bonuses), travel at very high speeds and orbit planets.
Move with directional buttons or left stick. Aim with touch pad.
Press touch pad or Cross button to shoot, Circle button to do a super attack, Square button to charge/heal.
Press L1 and R1 to switch between linear and orbital movement mode.
Your goal is to destroy enemies that spawn randomly somewhere in the vast space of the solar system that you are guarding.
They can warp through the edges of the system. You can't."

10013432.name: DEADLY BALLS BOUNCE
10013432.description: DEADLY BALLS BOUNCE is a game in which you play as a cannon that moves in one straight line and can fire in two directions. Your goal is to shoot down enemy objects. There will be obstacles in the path of the projectile, from which the projectiles will bounce. The lower the enemy goes, the more points you get. Enemies also emit projectiles, which you should dodge, because if a projectile hits you, the game will end.

10006857.name: Marsi's Adventures
10006857.description:
Marsi's Adventures is a classic single-screen 2D platformer where you have to collect three stars, overcome some obstacles and get to the final teleport.
Features:
- Single-Player adventure.
- High quality arcade music.
- Beautiful artwork.
- 10 to 30 minutes of gameplay.
- 15 levels.

10013118.name: Path Of The Builder
10013118.description:
Path Of The Builder is a casual, physics-based game that takes players on a journey of destruction and creativity, where every ruin holds the potential for a masterpiece. Armed with powerful tools, players demolish old structures piece by piece, collecting valuable resources to construct innovative new creations.
Switch between the thrill of smashing through walls and the satisfaction of designing unique structures from the ground up. Whether building simple homes or grand monuments, every level presents new challenges that require both strategic resource management and creative construction skills.
Dive into the story-driven campaign to complete engaging missions or let your imagination roam free in sandbox mode. "Path Of The Builder" lets you experience the thrill of transformation, as you turn ruins into works of art.

10006018.name: PUMP PRESS
10006018.description:
PUMP PRESS is a fast-paced one-button game.
You control a robot that is constantly moving forward. Your goal is to pump the balloons that are coming towards you by shooting them. If you shoot a balloon 4 times, it will pop. Press a button to shoot and hold a button to go faster. The balloons will remain behind you once they pass you and deflate again. The enemy will push all deflated balloons to the left border. You score points for every balloon that hits the border. To score more points, chain up the balloons.
The game is over when you hit a deflated balloon.

10012172.name: SKI ZONE
10012172.description:
Prepare yourself, skier! In this fast-paced arcade game, you'll be sliding down an endless hill with only one button!
SKIZONE controls with any button. When you press it you will switch directions, and if you hold it you will slow down, allowing you to control your speed.
The objective is to cross over every possible checkpoint. Your score bonus will increase with each consecutive checkpoint you successfully cross, but it will reset if you miss one. If you hit one of the checkpoint corners or go off trail, it's game over!

10012200.name: SLALOM
10012200.description:
Did you ever want to drift like the pros? Well, get ready to challenge yourself in SLALOM!
In this fast paced one-button arcade game, you'll control a car's drift as you slalom through an endless road filled with barriers. Hold any button to make the car turn to a set direction and avoid the barriers. Each time you pass one, your direction will flip, so be mindful!
Score points by drifting as close as possible to the barriers. The closer you pass it, the more points and trophies you'll get! However, if you hit it, or drift off-road, is an instant game over!

231931.name: State of Anarchy: Master of Mayhem
231931.description:
State of Anarchy: Master of Mayhem is a hilarious shooter that will put a smile on your face. You were an ordinary citizen in a small town… Now it’s on fire! Rioters are storming the houses, aliens rampage in the sky! Run as fast as you can! Shoot anything that moves! Do not release the gas pedal!
Anarchy has never been so much fun!
Features:
- intense action
- hilarious doodle graphics and mouth made sound effects
- 60+ weapons. New gun on every level!
- 100+ enemies and bosses
- 3 cars and 6 spaceships
- talents and weapon upgrades
- 48 stages
- awesome rock music

204190.name: STEINS;GATE 0
204190.description:
Steins;Gate 0 is the sequel to the best-selling Visual Novel.
Set around a group of students who accidentally change time and history with a science experiment, endangering humankind.
Steins;Gate 0 tells the story of what happens when they fail to fix their mistake...
1 player
6GB minimum save size
Software subject to license (us.playstation.com/softwarelicense). Online features require an account and are subject to terms of service and applicable privacy policy (playstationnetwork.com/terms-of-service & playstationnetwork.com/privacy-policy). One-time license fee for play on account’s designated primary PS4™ system and other PS4™ systems when signed in with that account.
©MAGES./ 5pb./ Chiyo st.inc. ©2009 MAGES./ 5pb./ Nitroplus. Published by PQUBE Ltd.

10014127.name: Ultimate Sparring
10014127.description:
Unleash the Champion Within!
Step into the ultimate boxing arena and test your skills like never before with Ultimate Sparring! Deliver precise jabs, powerful hooks, and dynamic uppercuts to rack up points, string together epic combos.
Experience lifelike visuals, a heart-pounding soundtrack, and addictive gameplay that draws you into the action from the very first punch. Whether you're a boxing fanatic or simply love the thrill of chasing high scores, one thing is clear: your unstoppable drive to win will set you apart.
Gear up, take on the punching bag, and etch your name into boxing history. Ultimate Sparring – where your training becomes legendary!

228918.name: Akash: Path of the Five
228918.description:
Akash: Path of the Five is a visual novel in the otome style.
Players will become Aurora, a member of a magical race of elementals. As the first elemental girl the village of Akash has seen in over 200 years, all eyes are on her fast-approaching Coming of Age Ceremony. All is not as it seems, however, as tensions between Akash and a nearby human settlement threaten to erupt into an all-out war. Cultivate a romance with one of her classmates, navigate the coming conflict, and plan the greatest coming of age ceremony  Akash has seen in over two centuries.
Featuring:
• 7,000+ lines of dialogue voice by a veteran cast: Morgan Berry, SungWon Cho,Ray Chase, Andrew Love, Chris Patton, Brandon McInnis and more.
• Over 70 collectible CGs.
• 6 potential love interests.
• Up to 25 possible endings.
• An original orchestral score by Fat Bard.
• Hi-res character art and stylized 3-D environments presented at native 1080p on PlayStation®4, with an enhanced 4K presentation on PlayStation®4 Pro.

10016391.name: Green Soldiers Heroes: Extreme Bikers
10016391.description:
Inspired by the classic and fun arcade motorcycle games of the 90s. With low-poly graphics reminiscent of the 32-bit era of console gaming.
Challenge Mode
Addictive gameplay that challenges players to complete 30 courses in search of the next checkpoint before the time limit.
Free Mode
Ride freely through the city, race at high speeds, jump over ramps and buildings. Explore every corner in search of Money Packs so you can buy new bikes.

10009996.name: Santa's Speedy Quest
10009996.publisher: ERIK GAMES YAZILIM OYUN TEKNOLOJILERI TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
10009996.description: Dive into festive fun with our new Christmas-themed game! Embark on a winter wonderland adventure featuring 8 mini-games that progressively intensify, putting your reflexes and holiday spirit to the test. Brace yourself for an ever-increasing thrill as the games get progressively more challenging. Embrace the holiday spirit, set high scores, and make this Christmas season unforgettable with our jolly game!

232625.name: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE: IRON RAIN
232625.description:
●50+ Missions in Five Difficulties
The furious battle against the invader Aggressors is full of chaos. Includes 50+ severe missions, where you must fight against gigantic enemy creatures and huge invader weapons in 5 different difficulties.
●4 Mobile Soldiers and Weapons
You will become the legendary mobile soldier which controls 4 different PA Gears, several hundreds weapons, arms and items. Regain hope to human beings.
●Bring Personality to the Battlefield
Includes character creation mode. You can select your favorite gender, face, hair style, weight, voice and outfit. You can also change the personality of yourself.
●Enriched Offｌine and Onｌine Mode
When playing the off-line mode, the split-screen will be supported. Also, when playing the on-line mode, you can co-op with other EDF members around the world.

10015562.name: Memory Holder: The Alphabet
10015562.description:
A memory game dedicated to the letters that guide us through the day.
Memorize the Alphabet across fifteen stages and try to unlock all rewards by earning enough stars.

10011988.name: Reflector satellites
10011988.description:
In Reflector Satellites, you play as a space defender fighting off an endless number of enemy ships. Your opponents are ships of three colors: red, blue and yellow. Use mirrors to redirect your shots and destroy enemies more effectively.
Every time you destroy three ships of the same color in a row, you receive bonus points. This requires strategic planning and precision to make the most of your attacks. Assess the situation, control mirrors and destroy enemies to score as many points as possible.

10017638.name: Santa´s Gifts Load
10017638.description:
In this game you must drop Christmas presents into a box to hold them on balance.
The presents affect the balance according to their distance from the motorcycle.
Match 3 presents of the same color vertically or horizontally to remove them from the playfield.
Every Christmas present hast its own weight, so let them fall wisely. The weight is shown as a number on a present.
If one side of the box hits the ground, the game is over.
Use specials like “column cleaner”, “row cleaner” and the “joker present” for a faster playfield cleaning and better score.

10009167.name: AWAKEN - Astral Blade
10009167.description:
STORY
Bionic girl Tania is assigned by her creator, Dr. Herveus to search and rescue a missing Investigation team in the rainforest of Horace Islands where mysterious Karpas energy turns local animals and plants into aggressive mutants.
Weave your own story in this dark fairy tale. In the mysterious ancient ruins, you will embark on an adventure with Tania to reveal her origins and fate. Is there any chance of survival in this darkest and desperate place though?
AWESOME AND EXCITING COMBAT
Slain your foes with a wide range of combos: from fastest to slowest. Parry enemy attacks to gain an advantage, use Quick Rise ability to get back into the fight and dash into enemies while they’re attacking to slow the world around you and gain damage immunity. Combos and Skills will also help you to break through hordes of enemies and defeat bosses.
RICH PLOT AND VARIOUS ENDINGS
Control the course of the story, help Tania make choices at the crucial moments of the game and take your own path to reveal mysteries of the past and present. Different routes may lead you to different endings. Search the Horace Islands for clues and information about mysterious and dangerous world of the AWAKEN - Astral Blade.
CUSTOMIZE AND UPGRADE
Collect mysterious Aether and use it for your own benefits. Enhance Tania’s combat abilities and strength, or spend it on different skills useful in various situations. What about upgrading your weapons or trading some Aether for useful items? The choice is yours.
A NEW AND INTERESTING WAY TO PLAY
Don't waste your time on travel. The map is designed to save you time while exploring it. Should you have troubles in combat, you can lower the difficulty level and get some useful buffs. Tania always finds cheerful words for you even in your darkest hours. Because this is not only her story, but yours as well.
CATS
Yes, you can pet cats in the game /ᐠ｡ꞈ｡ᐟ\

10012788.name: Buildozer Simulator
10012788.description:
Step into the world of Buildozer Simulator, a captivating simulation experience where demolition meets construction in a dynamic, ever-evolving environment. Armed with a range of powerful tools, you'll take down buildings piece by piece, salvaging valuable resources to create new structures from the ground up. Each level presents a new challenge—whether it’s efficiently demolishing skyscrapers or constructing grand buildings, your success depends on smart resource management and precise execution.
Feel the thrill of smashing through walls with wrecking balls and explosives, then switch gears as you design and construct everything from simple homes to towering skyscrapers. With realistic physics and satisfying destruction mechanics, Buildozer Simulator offers an immersive blend of strategic dismantling and creative building, ensuring hours of engaging gameplay.
Whether you're tackling a story-driven campaign or letting your imagination run wild in sandbox mode, Buildozer Simulator gives you the tools to construct your dreams—and destroy everything standing in your way.

10014775.name: Cazzarion: Little Dragon
10014775.description: FluffySpark is a curious little dragon who lives on a tropical island filled with lush forests and sparkling lagoons. One day, FluffySpark discovers that his dragon family's eggs have been stolen and scattered across the island! Since FluffySpark can fly, he decides to collect the lost eggs.

10013120.name: Christmas Racing
10013120.description:
Christmas Racing is an action-packed racing game and your focus is to be the first and surpass your opponent. The terrain is treacherous, so you need to pay attention to your speed and really do everything you can to improve.
This is the ultimate holiday-themed race where you must use all your skills and become a great driver. There are multiple cars to choose from and you will be impressed with the numerous gameplay mechanics and ideas. Check it out today and see if you can defeat all other drivers!
Features:
• Christmas themed racing game
• Play in local multiplayer
• Multiple cars to choose from
• Beautiful, immersive visuals
• Lots of replay value

10012709.name: Chronos Time
10012709.description: In Chronos Time, time isn't just ticking—it's your ultimate puzzle! Set the clock, solve the mystery, and unlock the future in this captivating  game. With each mission, you'll adjust an old-school digital clock to the perfect time using intuitive controls. But don’t let the simplicity fool you—each time setting reveals a new piece of the puzzle!

10014745.name: Chronos Time 2
10014745.description:
Set the time. Shape the world. Unlock the next era.
In Chronos Time 2, you don’t just visit the past or future — you live within it. Control a mysterious Nixie tube clock to shift the time of day, summon storms, or trigger ancient rituals. Every era reacts to your precision, and only by solving its unique time-based puzzles can you move forward.
Start in the present — but your journey spans medieval kingdoms, futuristic cities, and even the age of dinosaurs.

10011627.name: Cube Stack Ultimate
10011627.description:
Cube Stack Ultimate is an incredible game of stacking cubes that provides endless enjoyment.
Simply adjust the cube to the proper position and try to minimize crashes to achieve a high score, as you will lose a small square of the cube when it slides and you tap for the next cube.

234601.name: Dreaming Canvas
234601.description:
Dreaming Canvas is an educational art-history learning game.
In Dreaming Canvas you are free to choose your destination and explore it at your own pace. Meet interesting other travelers along your journey, listen to inspirational art quotes from famous painters and locate canvasses scattered around the landscape...
When you find a canvas, get ready to paint the landscape of your dreams...

10005656.name: Elliot - My First Date RPG
10005656.description:
A game in the "ProjectSummerIce.com Presents: My First Date RPG" series!
This game's release is part of Breakthrough Gaming's "Bible Video Game Sundays"!
Purchase and play our new Christian themed video games releasing every Sunday morning* in the PlayStation™Store today!
(*Release dates subject to change)
[About Breakthrough Gaming]

10015260.publisher: Fabrizio Ballante trading as Colosseum Studio
10015260.description: Get ready to put your reflexes to the test in this adrenaline-filled platformer where the only goal is survival! Make impossible jumps, dodge sharp blades, deadly traps, and unpredictable obstacles as you try to reach the end of each level. Every move could be your last—stay focused, plan your actions, and prove you have the nerves of steel it takes to make it to the finish line.

10011512.name: PILEUP
10011512.description: In PILEUP you play as a green square that is trying to rise up by substituting gray squares underneath it. Since reaching the top of the green square will end the game, you must prevent it from rising. Pink rectangles will fall from above and destroy all the blocks in their path, including you. Dodge them to live as long as possible and earn more points.

10006470.name: SNAKE 1
10006470.description:
SNAKE 1 is a fast-paced one-button game.
Play Snake with just one button. Collect coins to score points and to make the snake grow in size. Press a button to rotate 90 degrees. You rotate clockwise initially, but you reverse your direction every time you collect a coin.
The game is over when you hit any of the borders of the screen or the snake hits its tail.

10014715.name: Sport Soup
10014715.description: Collect positive dots and avoid the negative ones in this arcade game. Survive as long as possible and score as many points as you can!

10017117.name: Witness to Plague
10017117.description:
Are you interested in plague during the medieval  times?
Then, this short-quiz game is for you.
Test your knowledge of history of medieval plague and then unlock a short movie called "Witness to Plague"

With classic 8-bit tunes, tight controls, and fast-paced gameplay, Mythos Dash is your next favorite nostalgic game. Can you become the Hero of the Mythos?

In this driving puzzle game, your goal is simple but far from easy: find a way to exit the parking area by maneuvering with pinpoint precision. Watch out for obstacles, plan your route carefully, and make the most of every inch to get the truck out without a scratch. Do you have what it takes to master tight turns and impossible exits?

10005486.name: Frogo
10005486.description: You play as Frogo. Its goal is to pick as many strawberries as possible, avoid obstacles and reach the final destination alive.

231182.name: Where Are My Friends?
231182.description:
The Eyeball named Wheye had come to the planet where his friends studied local species. His friends went missing, the planet is about to blow and only Wheye can save everyone. He will have to face different trials on his own.
Features:
- 4 DIFFERENT GENRES IN ONE GAME!
Every level is a separate genre: runner, metroidvania, point'n'click quest and puzzle-platformer.
- GAME WITHOUT WORDS
The plot will be understandable to each one of you, since the story is told without using a single word.
- UNIQUE VISUAL STYLE OF EACH LEVEL

Are you looking for a great game to show off your unbeatable driving talent? You are in the right place. In this game, you can stump yourself and your friends in challenging tracks with magnificent landscapes. Each track comes with different challenges and each car has its own awesome features; Power, Control, Speed. Choose your car! Win the races! 10016386.name: Portal Shooter
10016386.description:
Portal Shooter is a game in which you need to close a deadly portal by playing as a powerful mage who revolves around it.
With the press of a single button, the mage can change direction, speed, and even attack the portal itself if the button is pressed quickly.
Close the deadly portal and bring peace to the continent!

10010357.name: R DRIVE
10010357.description:
Pedal to the metal, and turn the wheel to the right and... to the right!?
Looks like your car has a few technical issues, and the wheel can't turn left! Keep on moving, avoid obstacles and collect coins to speed up! Each coin will throw another obstacle so be careful... but hey, at least the brakes work!
You'll score by picking up coins and moving at high speeds! The faster, the more each coin's worth, but don't be afraid to hit the brakes if things get too hectic. However, if your speed reduces to 0 or you hit a wall or obstacle, you'll lose!

10013000.name: Slicy Flips
10013000.description:
Simple but addictive gameplay. Roll the knives and cut everything on your way.
Each level is made for your pleasure and happiness. Feel the real ASMR every second you play. Slicing the fruit can be so satisfying. Try it for yourself.
Find the right rhythm and make the gameplay smooth and perfect!

227128.name: Dark Rose Valkyrie
227128.description:
A virus threatens humanity…Valkyrie Force, move out! In this RPG, fight using customized weapons, team attacks, the powerful Overdrive mode, and more! But beyond battle, you’ll have to interrogate teammates to find who’s been turned in order to save the world.
Key Features
• Characters can transform into their stronger split personalities mid-battle, but be strategic – too many transformations will lead to Fatigue!
• Customize weapons and attack combinations for each character, and do more damage with Riot Combos, Simultaneous Attacks, and more!
• Depending on your choices, a team member will betray you. Find the traitor in visual-novel style interrogation sequences, and change the game’s ending!

10015368.name: Monster Survivors: Hunting Wilds
10015368.publisher: Kanuni games oyun YAZILIM VE Pazarlama Ticaret limited Sirketi
10015368.description:
In a world where darkness reigns, survival is only for the bravest! Monster Survivors: Hunting Wilds throws you into a relentless battle against monstrous creatures lurking in the wild. Face the horrors of the night and decide—will you be the hunter or the hunted?
Features:
Endless Battleground – Survive against relentless waves of monsters!
Legendary Abilities – Customize your combat style with 36 unique abilities.
Terrifying Enemies & Deadly Bosses – Battle 14 different creatures and 6 powerful bosses.
Challenging Maps – Adapt your strategy to survive in diverse environments.
Permanent Upgrade System – Enhance your armor, damage, health, and more.
The hunt begins! Can you and your team survive the nightmare?

10004670.name: NeonLore
10004670.description:
Neon-Lore is a first-person free form exploration game. You’ll meet interesting characters and discover what had happened to human race in the near future.
As you will roam along the neon-soaked streets, you’ll discover what the world has become, how life goes on in a world of intriguing fusion of chaos and technological advancement.
In Neon-Lore, you will solve puzzles and encounter with various characters and learn about their past life, dreams and fears…And get a chance to discover deeper about the social transformations that has impacted human life in the 21st century…
Features:
*Discover the world at your own pace.
*No failing or quests, you decide about how you explore the world.
*Beautiful, cyber-punk themed environments.
*Meet 40 different characters and learn about their backgrounds.
*Get access to 4 different audio books that contain 4 different cyber-punked themed novels, written exclusively for this game by sci-fi authors.
* Relaxing and exciting cyber-punk themed soundtrack.

10013224.name: Mini Crawler
10013224.description:
In this classic first-person Dungeon Crawler game with voxel graphics you play as a The Knight seeking to rescue his Princess. Collect powerful artifacts and defeat foes, play in Story Mode or in infinite Arcade Mode.

10017686.description: An addictive sci-fi puzzle game features 28 cleverly designed levels. The player's task is to build a beam from point A to point B, through objects that have different functionality.

203179.name: OKAGE: Shadow King
203179.description:
Experience OKAGE: Shadow King originally released on the PS2™ system with up-rendering and Trophies.
In an unexpected twist of fate, the spirit of an Evil King is unleashed and possesses the shadow of an innocent young boy, named Ari. Wielding the burden of the evil ghostly being, Ari and his friends must journey across a wonderfully animated, whimsical world. In this struggle between good and evil, light and dark, manage your team carefully or forever be held captive by the Evil King’s spirit.
This title has been converted from the PS2™ (PlayStation®2) version to the PlayStation®4 console. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PS2™ (PlayStation®2) version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PS2™ (PlayStation®2) system’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.

234049.name: Cybarian: The Time Traveling Warrior
234049.description:
Get the Sword of Ages, travel to the future and try to live long enough to brag about it!
Drawing inspiration from old school platformers, Cybarian: The Time Travelling Warrior is an arcade title with some beat ‘em up gameplay qualities. Across four levels, players must take control of Cybarian, a warrior who discovers the Sword of Ages and gets transported to a cyberpunk future.
Features:
* Beautifully animated and expertly realized retro-style pixel art.
* Epic boss battles!
* Expand your abilities!
* Explosive and engaging combat!
* Classic 2D platforming
* 3 supported difficulties (Easy, Normal and Hard)
This Cross-Buy product entitles you to download both PS4™ and PS Vita versions.

10008449.name: Envasion
10008449.description: In a few words Envasion is fast and furious game. Inspired by Galaxian, this game builds upon the great mechanic with new features and sleek modern performance. Just fight without hesitation. Who hesitates will die!

10000822.name: More Dark
10000822.description:
After the Lord of the Other World went on vacation his leadership was temporarily taken over by his sweet daughter, Evilina and chaos ensued. The prisoners of damnation have all escaped from their confinements and scattered about the kingdom, shattering the fragile peace of the devil’s dominion.
Your task is to return order to Hell, corral the escaped convicts, and cleanse each area of chaos and anarchy. Can you save Hell, or perhaps earn redemption?
Features:
* 60 levels
* Variety of mechanics
* Hidden keys to unlock hats
* Gloomy, stylish pixel graphics
* Retro-inspired music

10011684.name: Run, Sandwich, Run!
10011684.description: Making a sandwich is not as easy as it seems. There are many obstacles to overcome in the kitchen to make a delicious meal. You have to be sure to use all the tasty ingredients in the right order. Give it a try and see if you can do it!

234456.name: Afterlife
234456.description:
After a life-changing event, a family struggles with loss and attempts to mend their frayed bonds. Experience their struggle and explore Afterlife’s multiverse of different realities as the family acknowledges absence in their own lives. Using cutting-edge interactive film techniques, Afterlife takes you through a 360° branching narrative that seamlessly reveals a story that shifts based on the characters that you choose to follow and the objects you activate within the environment.
FEATURES
- Interactive film
- Shape the story by choosing which character you follow- Navigate and interact seamlessly in a rich 360-3D virtual reality live-action narrative
- No two playthroughs are alike: this branching story has 3 episodes, 29 unique choices, thousands of unique playthroughs and multiple endings
- Subtitles in English and French available (NOTE: Enabling subtitles will disable the 3D stereoscopic capabilities in order to avoid eye soreness while reading the text.)

10010124.name: Heaven Jump
10010124.description: Take an adventure with Heaven Jump, the endless jumping game! Fly to new heights in this fun challenge where you'll try to reach the highest score and collect stars along the way. Dive into the world of Heaven Jump, where classic 2D pixel arcade design adds a touch of nostalgia to your space journey. Elevate your gaming experience and reach for the stars.

228774.name: METAGAL
228774.description:
Players are thrown into the shoes of 'Meta,' a cyborg girl, in her quest to rescue her Creator 'Dr Ray' from the hands of 'General Creeper,' the evil leader of a rogue army!!
To make matters worse, Metagal's sisters were also kidnapped by Creeper and he’s turned them all into battle cyborgs, in order to use their powers so that he can at last, rule the world!! With no other option, Meta must face her sisters, free them, and copy their abilities, if she wishes to take down save those she loves and the world.
Features:
* Classic jump and shoot style platformer.
* 8 levels that each have their own unique environment, detailed designs and different gimmick.
* 30 Enemies types.
* Powerful new weapons that can be obtained by defeating each Gal Boss.
* Lots of secret collectible items that can be used to power up your character.
* Unlockable new characters to play with, each come with their own powers and upgrades.
This Cross-Buy product entitles you to download both PS4™ and PS Vita versions.

10000906.name: Micetopia
10000906.description:
Welcome to the medieval, magical kingdom of Micetopia, where mice live in freely an idyllic country village. Unfortunately as the story begins forces of evil have taken away all the mice except for the one elder remaining. Can you become the hero of Micetopia and save your villagers from the dark minions?
In Micetopia you play as a brave mouse who must fight, jump, and explore its way through a world of mystery. Overcome enemies, gain new powers and rescue your compatriots from the clutches of their captors. Do you have what it takes for the elder to bestow upon you the title “Hero of Micetopia?”
Features:
* Metroidvania style exploration
* Platform jumping and combat
* Classic pixel art graphics and chiptune sound

10000939.name: 112th Seed
10000939.description:
In a future where Earth has become uninhabitable and food is so scarce that most of humanity has perished, take the role of a seed that could restore hope! Make your way through the last labs constructed to cultivate a plant species capable of surviving any environment. Solve puzzles, avoid traps, grow plants and find an exit in this casual yet challenging pixel art platformer.
Features:
• Traverse 70+ levels of side-scrolling puzzle action.
• Acquire special skills to overcome the obstacles ahead.
• Retry stages as many times as necessary.
• Enjoy bite-sized level design for quick pick-up-and-play sessions.
• Overcome gradually increasing difficulty in the labs’ challenges!

10003502.description:
GUNGUNGUN is a frantic and fast-paced 2D arena shooter with an eye for details. Earn a high score and increase the bounty on your head while fighting on a runaway train crawling with enemies.

Become the fiercest lady on the police force! Take out the bad guys through 4 unique levels filled with challenging bosses and powerful special guns.

* Pick up special guns that will lead you to victory

10011399.description:
Are you ready to race?
Take control of your shiny racing car and become a true champion.
Happy Racer is a simple racing game that can be enjoyed by players of all ages. Watch out for other vehicles and slippery banana peels. Collect coins and speed boosts for extra fun.
Complete all 5 stages for victory.

231730.name: Nippon Marathon
231730.description:
San! Ni! Ichi! Hajime!!! Stretch your muscles and embark upon the ultimate marathon of Japan in a crazy party racer! Hurdle barrels, outrun Shiba Inu and dive out of the paths of bicycles - all while throwing fruit at your opponents and dashing across planks precariously balanced over waterfalls in an unreal marathon across the whole of Japan!

10013466.description:
Have you ever wondered how terrifying snails are? They stalk their prey slowly but mercilessly. You can't hide from them. They'll find you anywhere. Even years from now.
Eat these little people and grow. Grow and eat more. They're just your food. No pity. They are a slow instrument of death!

Meet Luzia, a sarcastic twelve-year-old with a playful sense of humor. If you believe what she says, My Big Sister is an RPG-like adventure game that is not about her but about her sister Sombria.
My Big Sister is a game about Luzia and Sombria, two sisters who are trying to get back home after being kidnapped by strangers and Luzia takes it upon herself to ensure they both make it home.
Across the game’s multiple chapters and played from a top-down perspective, in My Big Sister, players can expect to clear puzzles and find specific items should they wish to advance through the game’s story, but be sure to take your time. With plenty of secrets and multiple endings, you’ll have your work cut out for you to make sure you get the ending Luzia and Sombria deserve.
